agricultural price guarantees; energy and food self-sufficiency","mechanism":"published electoral program 2018-2024","outcome":"Platform proposed import substitution in energy and agriculture, with guaranteed prices for producers — partially contrad free-market orientation also expressed in same platform","dates":[],"quantities":[],"excerpt":"Se incrementaría la oferta de gasolina autóctona para reducir las importaciones y rebajar los precios, lo que requería poner en servicio más refinerías. Al contrario, asumía los principios ortodoxos del libre mercado, el libre comercio, la estabilidad macroeconómica, la disciplina presupuestaria, la flotación del peso y la autonomía del Banco de México, pero conjugadas, eso sí, con el rechazo al 'neoliberalismo', las 'tendencias privatizadoras' y la 'extranjerización' de sectores estratégicos.","locator":"extracted HTML block 63","attribution":"BOOK-013","period_fit":"Campaign period 2018; mixed economic model signals bear on 5B.3 (macroeconomic credibility) and 5B.1 (prosperity vs rents agenda)","source_limitations":["Platform-level statement of principles; implementation may diverge; tension between orthodox monetary/fiscal commitments and protectionist positions not yet tested"],"question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3"],"verification_status":"pending","verification_notes":[],"premium_verification_required":false},{"draft_id":"D0009","source_id":"BOOK-013","claim":"López Obrador's 2018 platform proposed resolving insecurity through addressing 'social causes' of violence (poverty, human development of vulnerable groups), gradual withdrawal of Armed Forces from internal security missions while deploying a new National Guard to 'pacify' Mexico within three years, and proposed closing inequality gaps especially in labor between men and women.","claim_type":"source_assertion","polarity":"favorable","actor":"López Obrador (campaign platform)","action":"proposed addressing root causes of violence; phased military withdrawal; new National Guard; gender labor equality measures","mechanism":"published electoral program 2018-2024","outcome":"Platform committed to security governance reform with social-prevention orientation and explicit gender equity in labor","dates":[],"quantities":[],"excerpt":"En el angustioso capítulo de la inseguridad, el Estado prestaría atención a las 'causas sociales' de la violencia, lo que pasaba por combatir la pobreza y elevar el desarrollo humano de los colectivos vulnerables. Se asumía el principio de la retirada de las Fuerzas Armadas de las misiones de seguridad interna pero sin precipitaciones, mientras se organizase y desplegase un nuevo cuerpo armado, la Guardia Nacional, con la meta de 'pacificar' México en tres años. security/social policy orientation relevant to 5B.6 (human capital and administrative capacity) and 5B.1 (broad-based prosperity)","source_limitations":["Pre-election platform; implementation subject to security conditions, military resistance, and fiscal constraints"],"question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6"],"verification_status":"pending","verification_notes":[],"premium_verification_required":false},{"draft_id":"D0010","source_id":"BOOK-013","claim":"López Obrador's 2018 platform proposed replacing the contested NAIM airport project — criticized for excessive costs and environmental impact — with Santa Lucía Airport (AISL) using existing military facilities, and promised free public Internet across the national territory.","claim_type":"source_assertion","polarity":"mixed","actor":"López Obrador (campaign platform)","action":"proposed replacing NAIM with Santa Lucía military-conversion airport;
